2) 칼슘 :  표시량(355.2mg/3200mg)의 80~150%
3) 마그네슘 : 표시량(122.1mg/3200mg)의 80~150%
4) 아연 : 표시량(6.98mg/3200mg)의 80~150%
5) 나이아신 : 표시량(8.28mgNE/3200mg)의 80~150%
6) 비타민 E : 표시량(8.2mg α-TE/3200mg )의 80~150%
7) 납(mg/kg): 3.0 이하

9) 붕해시험:적합

Health Functional FoodNiacin 8.28mgMagnesium 122.1mgVitamin E 8.2mgZinc 6.98mgCalcium 355.2mg2 times a day

인제 로얄 칼슘.비타민.미네랄 골드Niacin · Magnesium · Vitamin E · Zinc · Calcium

Made by 주식회사한미양행 · 2 times a day · 2 capsules

This product combines 8.28mg of Niacin, 122.1mg of Magnesium, 8.2mg of Vitamin E, 6.98mg of Zinc, 355.2mg of Calcium as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (2 capsules): 8.28mg Niacin, 122.1mg Magnesium, 8.2mg Vitamin E, 6.98mg Zinc, 355.2mg Calcium
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사한미양행

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Calcium
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day2 capsules per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (8.28mg / 3200mg), 80~150%
Magnesium labelled (122.1mg / 3200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (8.2mg / 3200mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (6.98mg / 3200mg), 80~150%
Calcium labelled (355.2mg / 3200mg), 80~150%
Appearance 연노랑색의 내용물을 함유한 적갈색의 연질캡슐 제품으로 이미, 이취가 없다.
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 고온다습한 곳이나 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Magnesium · Vitamin E · Zinc · Calcium together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
